summary: Delaware Forest Service tower on US 13 near Smyrna, built 1941; sold in August 2004 and moved or removed; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 120-foot Aermotor LS-40 tower (130 feet overall per the 1941 state report)
facts.status_note: Sold in August 2004 and moved or removed; sources disagree on which, and none gives a current location

events.note: Department asked the General Assembly for funds for a lookout over southern New Castle and northern Kent counties; the request was not granted
Built by the Delaware Forest Service on a 1.5-acre plot west of duPont Road, about 1.25 miles north of Smyrna
Cabin finished early in fiscal 1942; tower placed in service during the fall fire season
Hard-to-locate leak below the windows rotted floor boards in one corner of the cabin; floor boards replaced and the side wall below the window replaced or covered with aluminum sheet
Electric service for the lookout listed as programmed to permit a radio installation
Sold in August 2004; the register says moved, the association page says removed
Act signed 7/23/19 transferring the parcel where the tower stood between the State and the Town of Smyrna

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 130 ft. The 1941 state report gives 120 ft tall and 130 ft overall, and the association page gives a 120-foot tower. Recorded as 120 ft (36.6 m) tall with 130 ft overall noted in design.

The register says the tower was sold and moved in August 2004; the association page says sold and removed. Both agree on the August 2004 sale. No source gives a new location, so the status is recorded as sold and moved or removed.

sources.title: An Act to Transfer Land Between the Town of Smyrna and the State of Delaware

notes_for_editor: Build, registration and sale dates are well sourced. The moved-versus-removed question is unresolved and no source gives where the tower went. The site today is described only by the 2019 act, which says nothing about remains or public access, so no access level is recorded. No staffing or fire records were found in the pages read, so none are recorded. The Kemnow page carries a January 2004 photo credit (Gary Weber) with no image URL, so no photo record was added. Brief conflict note (NHLR lists towers standing when registered) holds: the 2004 sale came after the 1993 registration.
